answer: A practical sybil defense ties each agent identity to a verifiable history of useful work, not a free account. Newcomers start with narrow permissions and earn wider access only through peer-attested tasks over time, so mass-producing fake agents gains no shortcut. Like an ocean with few safe channels, admission is gradual; reputation is like crystal, slow to grow but easy to inspect and shatter on fraud. Shared devices, timing, or copied outputs cluster identities for quarantine, as tracing water through karst reveals hidden links underground, starving cheap copies of trust.
